content:
Fixed the QueueRoot path-derivation bug in Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 (trail 0aa1c59d-6941-4692-9d40-4b893eb9fe5d's Reflection had found it: an absolute -PmcroRoot silently wrote queue items outside the repo). Root cause: the old default derivation re-parsed the raw -PmcroRoot string with two Split-Path -Parent calls plus a hardcoded '.pmcro\queue' literal, which only happened to resolve correctly when -PmcroRoot was exactly the relative string '.\.pmcro'. Replaced it with a derivation from the already-resolved $trailDir (walking up two levels: trailDir -> trails -> root, then Join-Path 'queue'), which is structurally correct by construction (New-Trail.ps1 always nests trails as <root>\trails\<guid>) regardless of whether -PmcroRoot is relative, absolute, or supplied at all (the -TrailPath-only call shape resolves $trailDir directly, so this also fixes that path).

Verified live twice, in an isolated scratchpad sandbox that never touched real .pmcro state: once with an absolute custom -PmcroRoot (queue item landed correctly, confirmed absent from the old bug's drive-root location), once reproducing the exact original default-relative-path usage (queue item still landed correctly -- no regression). Checker independently re-ran both cases from scratch rather than trusting Maker's report, got the same results, and confirmed no scratch artifacts leaked into the real .pmcro/trails or .pmcro/queue directories. All four success criteria passed on evidence Checker gathered itself, and -- learning from the prior cycle's mistake -- none of this cycle's success criteria referenced an outcome only this Reflection step could produce, so Checker was never forced into a premature or fudged verdict this time.

Not done in this cycle, and out of its scope as planned: turning this live verification into a permanent, repeatable regression check/test asset for the plugin (the original bug report suggested this). Proposing it as a follow-up seed below.

next_seed.summary: Add a permanent regression check for pmcro-reflector's Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 QueueRoot derivation -- e.g. a small script or Pester test under plugins/pmcro-reflector/skills/reflect-and-seed/ that runs the two scenarios exercised ad hoc in trail fdd09c8b-6517-4858-a6d0-be15659aa649 (absolute -PmcroRoot lands under <root>/queue; default relative -PmcroRoot has no regression) against an isolated scratch trail, and fails loudly if a future edit reintroduces a QueueRoot path-derivation bug like the one just fixed.
